scope.claim_boundary: Fixed-before-sampling TASK-025 balanced-regular relation availability and matched GLV-orbit versus plain controls only; no solver, faithful PKC factor base, rank, recovery, secp256k1 target, scaling law, or ECDLP-complexity claim.

summary: The preregistered regularity gates passed on all six toy curve-arm aggregates, so one separately reviewed solver-slope proposal may be formulated. GLV-specific H_NEW was not retained: the orbit-minus-plain theta differences were -0.006987, -0.006329, and 0.000000 with overlapping intervals and zero qualifying sizes. The validated terminal is CLASSIFY_AS_KNOWN_LOCAL_SIMPLIFICATION.

stop_condition.statement: The complete frozen 3,000,000-trial grid reached the preregistered CLASSIFY_AS_KNOWN_LOCAL_SIMPLIFICATION terminal; the single-use authorization is consumed and no rerun is permitted.

residual_uncertainty: The experiment did not use the source-faithful PKC 2016 factor-base construction.
Relation independence, matrix rank, polynomial solving degree, memory growth, recovery, and end-to-end cost remain unmeasured.
The three toy subgroup sizes do not establish persistence at 256 bits.
No GLV-specific new mechanism survived the matched controls.
reopening_condition: Do not reopen this fixed-target yield run. A new HYP-M16-SOLVER-SLOPE-001 proposal must define a source-faithful relation family, end-to-end solver metrics, controls, scaling kill criteria, and a separate dated authorization.
